§6High Energy Field Jammer§f

§aCraft it, place it, forget it. Suppresses Folkvangr within 300 blocks.§f

The High Energy Field Jammer is a simple block that disrupts Folkvangr fields. It requires no power and no maintenance.

§6Recipe§f:
Starmetal Ingot + Versatile Circuit Board + Starmetal Ingot
Versatile Circuit Board + Alexandrite + Versatile Circuit Board
Starmetal Ingot + Versatile Circuit Board + Starmetal Ingot

§6Effect§f: If a DFC meltdown or any Folkvangr-type explosion occurs within a §e300-block§f spherical radius, the jammer nullifies it immediately. No terrain damage, no entity damage.

§cWARNING:§f The jammer does NOT save the DFC core. The core is still destroyed. It only prevents the area destruction that follows. It's a safety net, not a substitute for proper stabilizer setup.

§ePS:§f Place at least one before your first DFC startup. Consider a second as backup. The recipe needs starmetal, so make sure your cyclotron is producing it.
